title: Behaviour module manifest
description: What a behaviour module declares, checked when a world loads (docs/design/rebuild.md 5.2): its parameters (types, units, ranges, and each figure's source or that it's a placeholder), what it relies on perceiving, the beliefs it keeps (for truth audits), the decisions it records, and that its state can be saved (for checkpoints). A world that doesn't give a module what it declares is refused at load, naming the module.

name.description: As worlds name it in controller.impl, e.g. citizen.default.

doc.description: Where its rules are documented, with their sources.

perceives.description: What it relies on perceiving: the seat's channels must provide each.

beliefs.description: Beliefs it reports each wake for truth audits (docs/design/rebuild.md 8.2).

decisions.description: Domains of the decisions it records.

state.description: Whether it saves and restores its state, for resuming from a checkpoint.

keeps.description: Whole collections its seats are shown unasked because this is the office that keeps them (the land registry its register, a bank its customers' instructions), each with the reason. Nobody is shown a whole register, population or map unless its module says so here (docs/no-god-view.md).

boundary.description: What it carries of the world's edge: boundary conditions of the simulation it is handed (the weather to come, the outside market's scripted prices), each with the reason (docs/no-god-view.md).

schema.description: A JSON Schema for its value.

unit.description: e.g. cents, bps, days, seconds, count.

required.description: The world must give it (whom a module deals with, a place's figures).

source.description: Where the default figure comes from; 'placeholder' when it's unsourced.

what.description: A statement kind (enrolment), a record type (records:claim), directory, map, every entity of a kind (every:factory), or future.

why.description: Why this kind of participant holds it whole, in words.

about.description: What in the world it's checked against.
